tree.heading: In general
tree.text: In addition to amounts transferred under section 20904(c) of this title, there are authorized to be appropriated for requirements payments under this subpart the following amounts:

children.text: For fiscal year 2010 and subsequent fiscal years, such sums as are necessary for purposes of making requirements payments to States to carry out the activities described in section 21001(b)(3) of this title.

tree.heading: Availability
tree.text: Any amounts appropriated pursuant to the authority of subsection (a) shall remain available without fiscal year limitation until expended.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 15407 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
